case_id_order: Every split uses the same ascending case_id sort for split-case JSONL and question-list hashes. Development, validation, and test do not use encounter order for those digests.

steps: replace every Unicode whitespace run with U+0020
replace CRLF and CR with LF
SHA-256 of the exact raw bytes of the review artifact
SHA-256 of the exact ciphertext bytes
sort records by case_id using ordinary UTF-8 string order
emit each record as one canonical JSON object followed by one LF
SHA-256 of the resulting UTF-8 bytes
used_by: test public_cases_sha256 of redacted public cases only

steps: collect question_sha256 or public question_commitment_sha256 values
order the array by the corresponding case_id
canonical compact JSON array (ensure_ascii=false, separators (',', ':'), no trailing whitespace)
treat the dedup report as a JSON object
do not hash pretty-printed or key-unsorted variants
SHA-256 of exact raw file bytes
32-byte salt || UTF-8 of the gkr-m1-hash-profile-v1 normalized question

note: Independently conforming authors must use these preimages. Case folding or whitespace collapsing that differs from this profile is a different digest. Development and validation may bind canonical full-case JSONL digests. The public suite test split must not bind a digest of full test questions, full oracles, salts, or plaintext staging bytes. The freeze API binds a caller-supplied SHA-256 attestation digest for the dedup report; it does not load that file or recompute its preimage. Gate 1 binds no retrieval-configuration digest.
attestation_boundary: dedup_report_sha256 is externally computed under this profile. Runtime content verification of that artifact is out of freeze scope. A Gate 2 retrieval-execution digest, when it exists, is outside this Gate 1 hash profile binding.
